messages:
alex: handing off the nightwatch. quick summary:
- incidents: INC-4523 (embed queue backpressure) — mitigated, reduced ingress by 30% and scaled embed-pool-2x. still watching evictions.
- incident: routing-canary in eu-west1 spiking 95th p95 ~ 420ms, rolled canary back to v1.2.1 -> fallback to stable.
- what I did: scaled pool, drained stuck batchers, restarted kvcache workers on node-7, opened a brief bridge at 02:10 UTC.
- blockers: PR #3421 (kvcache eviction fix) needs an extra integration run (flaky in staging). will need one more +1.
- next: monitor embed evictions, let oncall know if evictions > 100/min, run smoke after PR merges, watch routing-canary when it restarts.

sara: noted. I'll own alerts for the next 4h. set an alert mute for noisy embed requeues but left the high-priority one on. ping me if evictions cross 60 in 5m window.

mike: I can run the integration tests for PR #3421 now. small heads-up: saw a flakey manifest error locally, if it fails I'll push a tiny test fix and re-run.

oliver: leaving a short fallback command in case embed pool needs immediate relief:
```
kubectl scale deploy/embed-service --replicas=6 -n production
redis-cli -h redis-primary EVAL "return redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])" 1 embed:throttle
```
Use only if autoscale lags.

oncall-bot: INC-4523 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. alerts suppressed: false. triggered 3 times in last 30m. link: https://incidents.internal/INC-4523

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed for routing-canary -> stable v1.2.1 (deployed by ci/cd). change-id: d3f9b8

alex: thanks all. sara — I'll slack you the logs for the kvcache workers and the PR link. mike/oliver if you see anything during the tests, drop notes here. leaving detailed timestamps in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
